summary: [correctness] Same class as the compact finding in two more places. (1) PLUGIN_SYNC_INCOMPLETE: `run/plugin.rs` answers it whenever `outcome.is_clean()` is false, so a root whose `overlay_candidates` fails (plugin_sync.rs:320, before any write), a dry-run, or a run where every candidate failed answers 'the candidates that were written stay' with nothing written; the brief F3 says 'some candidates not written', the audit says 'wrote some candidates'. Gate it on `!dry_run && total_written() > 0`. (2) RETENTION_PURGE_INCOMPLETE: retention.rs sets `deleting` before `purge()` is called, so a purge that fails with deleted == 0 (the `_ => (0, 0)` arm) is INCOMPLETE with 'what was deleted stays deleted'; use the counts the error already carries.
